# Replica methodology

Source: https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/replica-skill

Reviewed revision: `77c9436fb3d18c3d58169efb8caf4fe906b0dc51` (2026-10-23).
Author: Jake Schincariol. License: MIT; retained in `LICENSE`.

VELIA adapts the recon, entrepreneur, test and diff methodology into compact,
reviewed stage guidance in `desktop/project_workflow.py`. The Python tools and
the complete upstream skill prompts are not installed or executed. Existing
account ownership, Flash quotas, project resources and conversation storage
remain authoritative. No upstream runtime dependency or automatic updates.

Differences: RU/EN/TR lexical feedback triage preserves unmatched languages;
mandatory missing/untested cases and open S1/S2 issues block readiness regardless
of aggregate score. Evidence URLs are explicitly user-supplied, not verified
execution. The test stage creates a plan; it does not run code or probe a target.
